title: Switchboard: AI change workflows on AWS
description: A synthetic customer-change demo on AWS: an AI investigator gathers evidence, application code enforces approval, and signed test events check delivery.
seoTitle: Switchboard | AI Change Workflows on AWS | Hanif Carroll
seoDescription: Inspect a synthetic Python and LangGraph workflow on AWS with authorization checks, independent approval, durable jobs, idempotent receipts, and delivery verification.
role: Solo workflow design, agent and backend engineering, frontend, deployment, and monitoring
problem: Changing where customer events are sent requires checking the request, company policies, and the destination before making an update.
solution: Built an AI investigator that checks customer records and policies and links its findings to the evidence.
Required approval from another authorized employee before applying a change and checking delivery.
Deployed on AWS with SAM and CloudFormation, automated releases, and monitoring.
result: A public demo with three built-in fictional employee profiles, isolated visitor workspaces, real AI investigations, human approval, and signed test events between controlled AWS endpoints.
